_comment: TMDB cannot be searched by Finnish distributor title: it matches original, English and registered alternative titles only, and language=fi-FI does not widen the match (probed 2026-08-27). Key is enrich_tmdb.norm() of the title as the cinema publishes it. Value is either a TMDB movie id as a string, which skips the search entirely, or a replacement search string. run-enrich.log lists every title that found no id, which is what belongs here.

_comment_practical_magic: 2026-09-16. The Finnish distributor title of the 2026 sequel is "Practical Magic: Lumotut sisaret", with no 2 in it, and TMDB holds that same string for the 1998 original, 6435. So the exact-title rule matched confidently onto the wrong film and 256 showtimes over 32 providers and 46 venue files carried 1998's poster, its 6.8 from 1853 votes and its trailer. The two chains that publish the title with a 2, Bio Savoy (PRACTICAL MAGIC 2) and Kino Akseli (Practical Magic 2: Lumotut sisaret), matched 1302904 all along, which is what pins the identity here rather than a judgement about which film a cinema meant. Ids read off the records: 1302904 is Practical Magic 2 (2026), 2h10, released 2026-09-11 in Finland; 6435 is Practical Magic (1998), 1h44, released 1999-02-19 in Finland. The 256 rows publish 129 or 130 minutes where they publish a runtime at all, and run 2026-09-15 to 2026-10-01. Kino Tar appends a strand to the title as a suffix, which run.py does not split, so that spelling needs its own key. Known cost: a repertory screening of the 1998 film published under the bare Finnish title would now take the sequel's id. None is in the data today, and the alternative is 256 wrong rows.

Four keys because the alias is keyed on the title as each chain publishes it: the two live spellings, the weak one with the year in the parenthesis, and the older BioRex one, which is left in place because a chain that reverts costs nothing here.
_comment_2026_09_19_weak: 2026-09-19. Twenty-four keys from one run-enrich.log's "weak match, no exact title" list of 33. What makes almost all of them weak is one mechanism, measured rather than assumed: search runs with language=fi-FI, and where TMDB holds no Finnish translation the response's `title` falls back to the ORIGINAL title, not to the English one, so a cinema publishing TMDB's own English title can never match exactly. "The Time That Remains" comes back as الزمن الباقي, "Tiger on the Beat" as 老虎出更, "Faust" as "Faust - Eine deutsche Volkssage". Every id below was read off /movie/{id} and never typed from memory. Six of the weak candidates the log named are the WRONG film and are recorded here so no later session writes them: Klassikkoelokuva: Solaris -> 1080916 is a Titanic documentary, Baletti: Pähkinänsärkijä -> 446700 is the Bolshoi's Hero of Our Time, Konsertti: Il Volo -> 67572 is Disney's The Band Concert, Ooppera: Don Giovanni and Ooppera: Madama Butterfly -> 444446 is the Met's Idomeneo, Star House Movie -> 967969 is Council House Movie Star, Ryhmä Hau: Dinoelokuva -> 893723 is Mahtipennut, Black Magic Rites -> 331647 is a 2001 Fratter film, The Royal Opera: Tosca -> 1482356 is the 2025/26 season. Where an id below differs from the log's candidate, that is why.

_comment_acme_original: Iso-Hannu writes the undubbed print as "KOJOOTTI VS ACME (original)".
